description.en: If your receiver is not Radio Frequency (RF) capable, don't worry. All you need is a DIRECTV RF Remote and an external RF Antenna to control your DIRECTV® system without even pointing your remote at it.

attributes.productHighlights:
A Radio Frequency (RF) Remote allows you to control your DIRECTV® System without directly pointing at it.
In order for it to work, your DIRECTV receiver has to be equipped with a built-in RF Antenna.
If you have an older model receiver that's not RF-capable, you'll need an external RF Antenna.
